title: Ledger close posting interruptions
summary: Posting requests fail intermittently and replicas restart during the monthly close window.
precursor: A large tenant reconciliation was scheduled alongside the usual close workload, increasing the number of account lines processed in each run.
impact: Some ledger batches remain pending for manual replay, delaying close reports and balance confirmation for finance teams.

title: Catalog image processing delay
summary: New product images take several minutes to appear, with the oldest work items aging across multiple polling cycles.
precursor: A spring catalog refresh introduced higher-resolution uploads and a higher daily image arrival rate than the previous release period.
impact: Merchandising teams cannot reliably preview updated listings before scheduled promotions, and the image-processing queue misses its freshness target.

title: Customer search request pileup
summary: Search requests intermittently time out while active request counts climb and completed responses flatten.
precursor: A regional index refresh began during the morning traffic ramp, and search requests started taking longer than their normal service window.
impact: Support agents see incomplete customer results and retry searches, increasing wait times for callers seeking account assistance.

title: Billing-cycle queue backlog delays invoices
summary: Invoice status updates arrive well after the corresponding billing actions, and the oldest pending events continue to age.
precursor: A billing-cycle boundary caused a burst of invoice state changes while the consumer fleet remained at its weekday baseline size.
impact: Customer portals show stale invoice states and collections notices can be generated from outdated account information.

title: Warehouse reservation contention
summary: Reservation attempts slow down sharply during replenishment and a growing share end without a confirmed allocation.
precursor: A replenishment reconciliation began scanning multiple high-volume locations while order traffic continued at its afternoon peak.
impact: Checkout cannot confirm stock for some items, leaving orders awaiting allocation and increasing duplicate reservation retries.
